headline: Executive order freezes property of people who commit, threaten, or support terrorism and bans transactions with them.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this 2001 order blocks (freezes) property belonging to people and groups who commit, threaten to commit, or support terrorism. It also bans certain transactions with them. No official summary was provided, so details about how people are identified and which transactions are banned are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups who commit, threaten, or support terrorism
who_it_affects.how: Their property covered by the order is frozen, and others are barred from certain dealings with them.

who_it_affects.group: Banks, businesses, and individuals who handle money or property
who_it_affects.how: They are barred from certain transactions with people and groups covered by the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 23, 2001; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
